creator: kenji.watanabe
title: Cold Soba with Cucumber and Sesame
description: Rinse the noodles under cold water until they squeak. Warm soba in a cold dish is the one mistake here.
steps: Cook the soba for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold running water, rubbing the noodles until they no longer feel starchy.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and honey together.
Toss the drained noodles with the cucumber and the dressing.
Finish with sesame seeds and spring onion.

creator: menumatch.kitchen
title: Overnight Oats with Berries
description: Made the night before in the jar you eat it from. The ratio matters more than the toppings.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, maple syrup and salt together in a jar.
Fold the frozen berries through so they thaw into the oats overnight.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
Loosen with a splash more milk in the morning before eating.

creator: noor.haddad
title: Shakshuka
description: Make wells for the eggs and then leave the pan alone. Stirring after the eggs go in ruins it.
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until soft and beginning to colour.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the tomatoes, season well, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick enough to hold a trench.
Make four wells, crack an egg into each, cover the pan and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still move.
Scatter with parsley and take the pan straight to the table.

creator: tomas.lindqvist
title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Let the batter stand before it hits the pan. The oats need those ten minutes to soften.
steps: Blend the oats, bananas, eggs, milk, baking powder, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Let the batter stand for 10 minutes so the oats hydrate and it thickens.
Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Cook the pancakes for 2 minutes a side, until bubbles hold their shape on the surface before you flip.
Keep them warm in a low oven while you cook the rest.

creator: priya.nair
title: Masala Omelette
description: Breakfast in eight minutes. The onion should still have a little bite in it.
steps: Beat the eggs with the turmeric and salt until completely uniform in colour.
Stir in the onion, chilli and coriander.
Heat the oil in a small pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Cook for 3 minutes until the base is set and golden, then fold in half and cook for 2 minutes more.

creator: menumatch.kitchen
title: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Honey and Walnuts
description: Three ingredients, so all three have to be good. Toast the walnuts.
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and spread it to the edges.
Scatter over the walnuts, drizzle with honey, and finish with a pinch of salt.

creator: amara.okafor
title: Crispy Chickpeas with Smoked Paprika
description: Dry them properly and they shatter. Skip that and you get a chewy disappointment.
ingredients: drained, rinsed and dried on a towel
steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan.
Roll the chickpeas in a clean towel until they are completely dry and some skins have come loose.
Toss with the oil and spread them in a single layer on a tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, shaking the tray twice, until they rattle and no longer give when pressed.
Toss with the paprika, cumin and salt while still hot.

creator: menumatch.kitchen
title: Peanut Butter Energy Bites
description: No baking, no equipment. Chill the mix before rolling or it sticks to everything.
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl until there are no dry patches left.
Chill the mixture for 20 minutes so it firms up enough to handle.
Roll into 12 balls and keep them refrigerated.

creator: sofia.reyes
title: Air Fryer Halloumi Fries
description: Twelve minutes and no oil in the basket. Serve them the moment they come out.
steps: Pat the halloumi completely dry and toss it with the cornflour and oregano.
Arrange the fingers in the air fryer basket with space between them.
Cook at 200C for 12 minutes, turning once, until deeply golden and blistered.
Serve immediately with lemon to squeeze over.

creator: noor.haddad
title: Whipped Feta with Hot Honey
description: Whip it longer than feels necessary. It should hold a swoop like soft ice cream.
steps: Blend the feta, yogurt and olive oil for a full 2 minutes, scraping down twice, until completely smooth and airy.
Warm the honey with the chilli flakes for 1 minute, just until it loosens.
Spread the feta on a plate, pour over the hot honey, and finish with lemon zest.

creator: tomas.lindqvist
title: Dark Chocolate Olive Oil Mousse
description: No cream. The olive oil carries the chocolate and makes it taste more like itself.
steps: Melt the chocolate over a pan of barely simmering water, then take it off the heat and stir in the olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Beat the egg yolks in one at a time until the mixture is thick and glossy.
Whisk the whites to soft peaks, add the sugar, and whisk to firm peaks.
Fold a third of the whites into the chocolate to loosen it, then fold in the rest in two additions, stopping the moment no streaks remain.
Divide between glasses and chill for 3 hours before serving.

creator: tomas.lindqvist
title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Brown the butter, then let it cool before the sugar goes in. Hot butter makes flat cookies.
steps: Melt the butter in a pan and keep cooking it for 6 minutes, swirling, until the milk solids turn nut brown and it smells toasted.
Pour it into a bowl and let it cool for 15 minutes.
Beat in both sugars, then the eggs and vanilla, until thick and smooth.
Fold in the flour, bicarbonate of soda and chocolate until just combined, then chill the dough for 30 minutes.
Bake at 180C fan for 12 minutes, until the edges are set and the centres still look underdone.
Sprinkle with flaky salt and leave them on the tray for 10 minutes to finish setting.

creator: tomas.lindqvist
title: Lemon Posset
description: Three ingredients and chemistry. It sets on its own, so do not add gelatine.
steps: Bring the cream and sugar to a gentle boil, stirring, and let it bubble for 3 minutes.
Take it off the heat and whisk in the lemon juice and zest. It will thicken almost immediately.
Pour through a sieve into small glasses and chill for 4 hours until set.

creator: tomas.lindqvist
title: Salted Honey Roasted Pears
description: Firm pears only. Ripe ones collapse into the tray before they colour.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan.
Sit the pears cut side up in a baking dish, dot with butter and drizzle with honey.
Roast for 25 minutes, basting once halfway, until the cut faces are burnished and a knife slides in easily.
Sprinkle with flaky salt and serve warm with cold yogurt.

creator: menumatch.kitchen
title: Iced Mint Lemonade
description: Blended, not stirred. The mint has to break down into the drink to do anything.
steps: Blend the lemon juice, mint, sugar and 250ml of the water for 30 seconds until the mint is completely broken up.
Strain into a jug and top up with the remaining water.
Taste and adjust with more lemon or sugar, then pour over plenty of ice.

creator: menumatch.kitchen
title: Cocoa Banana Smoothie
description: Freeze the banana first. That is the entire trick to a thick smoothie without ice.
steps: Put everything in a blender with the frozen banana at the bottom.
Blend for 60 seconds until completely smooth and thick enough to hold a straw upright.
Pour and drink straight away, before it separates.
